title: What Owners Ask Me
<g>About AI</g>
subtitle: Four questions I hear every week. And what I say back.

cards.text: Can AI just run the whole business for me?
Not on day one. We find the one task that repeats every week, and start there.
Why not automate everything at once?
Because you'd automate a mess. We fix the process first, then AI takes it.
What if it sends something wrong to a client?
It can't. Nothing leaves without your yes.
And what happens when you're gone?
It runs in your business, in your words. You own it.
